outline:
一、教學目標： 簡介綠建築、永續都市之各項子議題，現階段專業界對本課題之解決概念及手法，並引介綠建築、永續都市規劃設計案例。
二、教學內容：1.思考生態環境、人類生活環境及建築之間的相互關係。2.綠建築、永續都市之內容。3. 引介綠建築、永續都市規劃設計案例。
This course focuses on the issues of the green buildings and sustainable cities. Its major content includes: 1. Study of relation between Ecosystem, human environment and architecture, 2. essay of Green Building and Sustainable Cities, 3. The case study of Green Building design and Sustainable City Planning.
